sourceEvidence.title: Staff Principal Systems Engineer 5
sourceEvidence.quote:
* Bachelor's Degree in a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Math) discipline with 12 years relevant experience; or Master's Degree in a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Math) discipline with 10 years relevant work experience, or PhD with 8 years of experience.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings
* First-hand experience with requirements and interface management
* Familiarity with system drawings and documents such as Interface Control Documents, System/Subsystem Specifications, Verification Cross Reference Matrices (VCRM), etc.
* Experience with system engineering tools such as IBM Rational DOORS
* Familiarity with MBE/MBSE concepts and tools
* Must be a US citizen
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a US Government Secret Clearance
